Claim-Support Relation can remain valid as root Evidence semantics while those questions are explicitly downstream ActionableEvidenceFor relations. Treating incompleteness as falsity would collapse Evidence and Actionable Evidence.

provisionalSurvivor.name: Evidence Resource + Decision-Scoped Epistemic Projection
provisionalSurvivor.compression: Evidence Resource semantics are claim-relative: preserve exact carrier/provenance/method/time and native support for explicit claims. Transportability, applicability/currentness, independence/common-mode, retrievability and decision value are downstream projections relative to Claim × Target × Decision × as_of. Direct target evidence is a residual/calibration anchor, not epistemic monopoly. Negative/failed evidence remains first-class. Evidence never becomes Knowledge without domain/owner promotion.

centralResult: The minimal Evidence semantic root is a provenance/method/time-bound support relation to an explicit Claim. Carrier identity alone is insufficient. Source-to-target transport, current applicability, retrievability/authority, set-level independence/common-mode structure, coverage/contradiction and decision/VOI are downstream ActionableEvidenceFor projections. C Universal Transfer Contract and D layered projection both survive 72/72 expressivity; D is preferred provisionally by decomposition/minimality/truth ownership, not because C is falsified.

rootCompression.evidenceCarrier: exact observation/artifact/trace/receipt identity; necessary for provenance/replay but not sufficient semantic evidence
rootCompression.claimSupport: support/contradict/bound/unresolved relation; minimal Evidence semantic root
rootCompression.provenance: required and claim-scoped; authentication does not grant universal semantic authority
rootCompression.methodObservationProcess: required when coverage, causal or measurement interpretation depends on how evidence was produced
rootCompression.time: observed/effective/available/known/applicability clocks remain claim-local and historical truth is immutable
rootCompression.transport: source-to-target relation downstream from Evidence existence
rootCompression.independenceCommonMode: Evidence-set relation relative to a bias/failure/falsifier class
rootCompression.coverageCompleteness: owner-native condition required before no-observation can become evidence of absence
rootCompression.retrievabilityAuthority: Actionability conditions, not historical claim-support identity
rootCompression.proxyEvidence: claim-bounded machine/Agent/synthetic falsifier sensor, not automatic Human/market authority
rootCompression.knowledgePromotion: separate domain/owner decision; Evidence never self-promotes

needles: `CarrierObservation` records point-in-time facts and failures without deciding whether a carrier is good:
A provider/egress failure therefore yields `fundingHistory=UNKNOWN`; it does not create a low carry score or a claim that the carrier is weak.
No later consumer may reinterpret `QUALIFIED` as trade permission.
`triageScore` is optional and exists only when every score input is observed.
FR3 therefore uses the same-day canonical 149-wrapper observation for deterministic semantic replay rather than treating present network instability as financial evidence.

theoryTriangulation.source: Ronald A. Howard, Information Value Theory (1966)
theoryTriangulation.importedRelation: information amount is not decision value; information value is decision/preference/uncertainty dependent
theoryTriangulation.nonTransferable: does not define Ordivon evidence ontology or a universal action threshold
theoryTriangulation.ordivonFalsifier: R8P03 same posterior produces different action and EVPI under different consequence structures

theoryTriangulation.source: Elias Bareinboim & Judea Pearl, Transportability of Causal Effects: Completeness Results
theoryTriangulation.importedRelation: source causal evidence may be reused in a target only relative to modeled source-target differences and available target information
theoryTriangulation.nonTransferable: formal causal transport does not automatically govern aesthetic preference, software receipts or noncausal claims
theoryTriangulation.ordivonFalsifier: Game/Human cases where external evidence creates transfer hypotheses but target-specific residuals remain

theoryTriangulation.source: Dahabreh et al., Extending inferences from a randomized trial to a new target population
theoryTriangulation.importedRelation: effect modifiers and selective participation can make source and target effects differ; target covariates can support transport
theoryTriangulation.nonTransferable: does not imply every Ordivon target needs a direct experiment or person-level re-estimation
theoryTriangulation.ordivonFalsifier: Human M0 heterogeneous individual effects + Evidence Transport contraction

theoryTriangulation.source: Hedges, Tipton & Johnson, Robust variance estimation in meta-regression with dependent effect size estimates
theoryTriangulation.importedRelation: multiple effect sizes sharing participants/investigator/lab can violate independence; raw effect count is not independent evidence count
theoryTriangulation.nonTransferable: statistical RVE is not a universal Ordivon evidence combiner
theoryTriangulation.ordivonFalsifier: Finance effectiveIndependentTrials and Workstation failure-domain independence cases

theoryTriangulation.source: Dahabreh et al., Global Sensitivity Analysis for Studies Extending Inferences From a Randomized Trial to a Target Population (2026)
theoryTriangulation.importedRelation: transport conclusions depend on assumptions whose violations can be sensitivity-tested rather than hidden
theoryTriangulation.nonTransferable: does not imply one global sensitivity parameter for heterogeneous Ordivon domains
theoryTriangulation.ordivonFalsifier: preserve transport residuals/moderators and contradiction rather than collapse to confidence
